verdict.rationale: Stripe has a dedicated prorations doc page, and it confirms you can preview a proration amount before applying a subscription change. That preview supports some up-front verification of mid-cycle changes. Beyond that single mention, the evidence pack does not describe how the math works, how credits are issued, or how prorated invoice lines appear. Missing for 10: documented proration calculation method (partial-period math), credit handling for downgrades, itemized invoice line items for prorations, evidence of penny-level reconciliation or audit trails, independent or hands-on corroboration.
